lede: One story pulled two different feeds the same way this Wednesday, September 9: Ben Shelton's US Open match against Carlos Alcaraz spiked on Google Trends and opened as a live market on Polymarket in the same window. In AI, Meta's launch of a personal agent called Muse carried from the news wires into a 409-point thread on Hacker News. Gamers stayed put, with Counter-Strike 2 holding the largest live crowd on Steam at just over 1.24 million concurrent players.

throughlines.title: ben shelton
throughlines.gist: A US Open match between Ben Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz drove a search spike and a live betting market in the same window, the day's clearest cross-feed signal.

throughlines.title: Muse – Meta’s personal AI agent
throughlines.gist: Meta's new personal AI agent, Muse, pitched around safety and privacy, moved from news coverage into a 409-point discussion on Hacker News.

throughlines.title: Not a comic [Jim K Benton]
throughlines.gist: A single Jim K Benton webcomic surfaced on both Lemmy and Mastodon's trending lists at the same time.
